title: Top 5 Spending Customers
content:
Question: Find the top 5 customers by total order amount.
SQL Pattern:
SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent
FROM demo.customers c
JOIN demo.orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5;

title: Category Sales Performance
content:
Question: List product categories with total items sold and net revenue.
SQL Pattern:
SELECT cat.name AS category_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_items_sold, SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS category_revenue
FROM demo.categories cat
JOIN demo.products p ON cat.id = p.category_id
JOIN demo.order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY cat.id, cat.name
ORDER BY category_revenue DESC;

title: Active Customers with Order Count
content:
Question: Find customers who have placed more than 3 orders.
SQL Pattern:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.email, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM demo.customers c
JOIN demo.orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.email
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 3
ORDER BY order_count DESC;

title: Low Stock Product Alert
content:
Question: List products with stock quantity below 10.
SQL Pattern:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.stock_quantity, c.name AS category_name
FROM demo.products p
JOIN demo.categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
WHERE p.stock_quantity < 10
ORDER BY p.stock_quantity ASC;

title: Average Order Value by Status
content:
Question: Calculate the average order amount for each order status.
SQL Pattern:
SELECT status, COUNT(id) AS order_count, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM demo.orders
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;
